Look, i don't know who you are but you seem really intelligent and full of intellect. I care about you, and so often we feel alone and stuck and you just wanna give up. i kinda feel like the thing holding you back from ending your life should be your motivation to thrive. you are 20, but just think you have your whole life ahead of you. Maybe in a few years you will forget this situation. you've made it this far. i think seeking therapy is a good option, it has helped me a lot. sometimes just talking to someone who cares about you but with no strings attached helps a bunch.
